item.title: Troopers Arrest Spickard Woman In Carroll County
item.description: A Spickard woman was arrested by State Troopers in Carroll County Saturday night. At about 10:00 pm, Troopers arrested 24-year-old Kimberly M. Pool of Spickard for alleged DWI with drugs and speeding. She was processed and released.
